subject: Marketplace addendum: billing & integration details for OrbitCloud listing
messages:
From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@orbitcloud.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft addendum + a couple questions on billing pass-through

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for taking time on the call earlier. Attaching our initial draft of a marketplace/reseller addendum for OrbitCloud listing. Two quick things we want to confirm before we send to our legal ops:

1) Pass-through fee language: we flagged the clause that says third-party marketplace fees are "passed through" to the customer. Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept an explicit gross-to-net adjustment (i.e., we invoice list price, Redwood remits net after marketplaces) or do you require Redwood to be the billing originator for those fees?

2) Integration metering: we need a short description in the Order Form explaining the metering hook and usage events that will flow from OrbitCloud (metering event schema attached). This is primarily ops/technical but legal wants a callout so billing can reconcile.

For context, our procurement team typically wants the pass-through carveout to include a 60-day audit window and backup CSV exports from Redwood. Is that something the addendum can reference?

Attaching: OrbitCloud_Addendum_v1_redlines.docx (redlines), Marketplace_Onboarding_SOW.pdf

Warmly,
Alex
Director, Business Development
OrbitCloud Systems

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
To: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft addendum + a couple questions on billing pass-through

Alex —

Thanks for the draft and clear flags. Quick answers up front:

- Pass-through billing: Redwood can support either model but we prefer to be the invoice originator when the customer purchases via the Redwood marketplace because that makes accounting & tax handling simpler for both sides. That said, for certain reseller deals we can accept a gross-to-net arrangement if OrbitCloud provides a signed reseller orderform and we have explicit reconciliation terms in the addendum.

- Audit/export window: 60 days is reasonable; we'll include a standard reconciliation clause and CSV export requirement.

- Metering hook: we need the event schema and a sample webhook payload. Our billing team will map fields to our usage metering table; please include the event name and timestamp granularity in the SOW.

Action items I propose:
- Redwood to produce a short mark-up that converts your redline into our preferred language for the pass-through vs invoice originator options. (Ben — can you take initial pass on the billing paragraphs?)
- Marissa — can you run a legal redline for the reconciliation/audit clause and confirm whether we need SLA language tied to data exports?
- Alex — please attach the metering example JSON and indicate whether OrbitCloud requires gross-to-net as a hard requirement for this listing.

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync if that helps.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft addendum + a couple questions on billing pass-through

Naomi / Marissa —

Taking the billing paragraph now. High-level take: we can offer two templates inside the addendum:

A) Redwood Invoice Originator: Redwood issues customer-facing invoices, collects marketplace commissions, remits net to OrbitCloud. Language will state Redwood is responsible for VAT/sales tax collection on the invoice, and OrbitCloud confirms list price assumptions. This minimizes reconciliation friction.

B) Gross-to-Net Reseller Flow: OrbitCloud invoices at list and remits to Redwood; Redwood issues credits or remits net amounts per monthly reconciliation. This path requires explicit monthly reconciliation files, a 60-day audit window, and a small operational fee to cover processing. We should add a fallback clause: if reconciliation is delayed >90 days Redwood may suspend the listing until resolved.

I've drafted paragraph stubs and inserted them in the redline (see attachment). Also added a short "metering events" appendix mapping the OrbitCloud event names to Redwood usage types.

Jonas — can you confirm whether the proposed 90-day suspension language is acceptable from a platform reliability standpoint? We need a quick yes/no so we can present both options to OrbitCloud.

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: OrbitCloud_Addendum_v1_redlines.docx (updated with billing stubs)]

From: Alex Ruiz <alex.ruiz@orbitcloud.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Sophie Grant <s.grant@orbitcloud.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft addendum + a couple questions on billing pass-through

Naomi —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. We reviewed Ben's stubs and OrbitCloud prefers option B (Gross-to-Net Reseller Flow) because of our existing distributor contracts. That said, we can accept the 60-day audit and the 90-day suspension fallback as long as there is a 30-day cure notice and a dedicated reconciliation contact on both sides.

Sophie (cc'd) will drop the metering JSON in a follow-up email by EOD. For the legal team, we're attaching a redline that accepts most of Redwood's edits but keeps our language on "listing fees" and marketplace commissions — we asked our counsel to retain a carveout that prevents double-charging to the end customer.

Next steps from our side:
- OrbitCloud to provide metering JSON (Sophie).
- OrbitCloud legal to run final redline and we can loop in our procurement counsel for signature.

Naomi / Marissa — can you confirm provisioning timeline if we accept option B and finalize the addendum this month? We need a go-live target so our marketplace onboarding team can schedule API work.

Thanks — look forward to wrapping.
Alex
Director, Business Development
OrbitCloud Systems
[Attachments: OrbitCloud_Addendum_v1_redlines_FINAL_BY_ORBITCLOUD.docx]
